text.p: Average yields at the latest auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month discount treasury bills fell from the last sale on January 28, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills fell to 29.87 percent from 30.19 percent, six-month bills slid to 34.51 percent from 35.39 percent, nine-month bills dropped to 40.62 percent from 42.31 percent and 12-month bills fell to 44.61 percent against 47.01 percent.
Results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15 million hryvnia 5 million hryvnia
Amount sold 9.39 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.74 million UAH 4.65 million UAH
The central bank sold 93,939 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
Results of Thursday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17 million hryvnia 5 million hryvnia
Amount sold 11.55 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.86 million UAH 4.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 115,519 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's auction of nine-month discount T-bills were as follows:
Issue volume 20 million hryvnia 5 million hryvnia
Amount sold 12.99 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.96 million UAH 3.79 million UAH
The central bank sold 129,879 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22 million hryvnia 5 million hryvnia
Amount sold 21.61 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.95 million UAH 3.40 million UAH
The central bank sold 216,061 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
